raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 was delivered twice: 345 rows at 02:00 and a full re-send of the same 345 txn_ids at 05:00. In the re-send, txn_ts is epoch milliseconds instead of a 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' string, which breaks the TIMESTAMP cast. 1768543211000 ms is exactly 2026-01-16 06:00:11 UTC, matching the original row, and the 5320 rows minus 4975 distinct txn_ids leaves exactly 345 duplicates, so the fix is to parse both formats and keep one row per txn_id.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, status, ingest_ts, batch_id, CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(trim(txn_ts), '[0-9]{12,14}') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(trim(txn_ts) AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions), dedup AS (SELECT * FROM parsed QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
